encoding_note: Schema note, deliberate and not drift. The tasking specified {candidate_id, date, auditor, verdict, findings, resolved_findings, cleared}. gates/scripts/vfinal_fold.py:74 reads audit.get('audit_verdict') and folds a missing key to REFUTED, and it reads audited_by nowhere but the batch convention carries it. Both the tasked names and the fold's names are therefore emitted, carrying identical values, so neither contract is broken. findings[] carries ONLY severities from the binding allowlist {minor, note, info}; vfinal_fold.py:77 counts any other severity as refutation-grade and fails closed. Discharged history lives in resolved_findings[] and cleared[], which the fold does not read.

cold_solve.method: All four solved from the repaired passage before reading any gate verdict for this round, arguing every option to a textual verdict. Keys were checked only afterwards.
cold_solve.agreement: 4/4 with the shipped keys, and 4/4 with both independent G-KEY rounds (verdicts-ruling/verdicts-gkey-las-r1.jsonl and -r2.jsonl, 8 legs, 8 pass, 0 kill, 0 flag; verdicts-gkey-resolved.jsonl for this cid is byte-identical to r1+r2 concatenated, so it is the merge of those eight legs and not a ninth-through-sixteenth independent vote — counted once here).
cold_solve.q1: B. P1 states the chain outright: 'Om en glipa fick sitta kvar obemärkt drog luften in, och det som skulle ha blivit kol brann i stället upp'. A inverts the thermal outcome (cooling, half-charred wood) against 'Veden skulle förkolna, inte brinna'. C asserts prolongation where the text says 'ett par timmar räckte för att göra en hel veckas arbete till aska'. D absolutises ('ofelbart', 'oavsett hur snabbt') the very outcome the round-the-clock watch exists to prevent, and contradicts the stem's own conditional 'inte upptäcks i tid'. Exactly one defensible answer.
cold_solve.q2: D. P3 states both halves and then designates the cause: 'Träkol är sprött. Varje omlastning och varje mil på ojämna vägar bröt ner bitarna till finkol och damm' against 'Tjäran låg stilla i sina tunnor och kunde fraktas nedför älven, lastas om och lagras över en vinter utan att förlora i värde', closed by 'Den skillnaden avgjorde var hantverken kunde bedrivas.' A swaps the two products' properties. B substitutes bulk and value-density for the durability the text names as decisive — and since the stem says 'enligt texten', substituting a different cause for the designated one is disqualifying, not merely unsupported. C invents a growing range for resinous pine; the text ties tar wood to barked stumps and roots, never to distance. Exactly one defensible answer.
cold_solve.q3: A. P5 gives Nyfeldt's objection in full: 'Det Bostrand tar för en transportgräns skulle då vara en ägogräns, och kartan skulle visa vem som ägde marken snarare än hur långt en slädlast nådde.' B reverses the arrow and would corroborate Bostrand rather than object to him. C attributes to her a blanket source-nihilism she never states. D (the rewritten option) lifts a real P4 detail — the 1870s foreman writing surnames only — and mis-attributes it to her; adversarially probed against her one other remark ('Stråkåsen är ett enda område och ... kronans avverkningstillstånd på 1860-talet var både få och kortvariga') and it does not reach: different decade, different object (felling permits, not bookkeeping), and that remark defends her position against Bostrand's counter-case rather than objecting to his boundary reading. Exactly one defensible answer.
cold_solve.q4: C. Requires joining P2 ('Årstiderna skilde dem åt. Tjärdalarna brändes helst på försommaren ... medan kolmilorna restes från sensommaren och in i oktober') to P4 ('av dem som sålde kol till Vresfallet levererade ungefär en tredjedel också tjära något år'). A is refuted twice over by 'Tjärbränningen krävde annat virke och annat kunnande' and by 'Kolarens skicklighet satt i vakthållningen; tjärbrännarens satt i själva klyvningen och resningen'. B upgrades 'ungefär en tredjedel' to 'så gott som varje'. D (the rewritten option) asserts two things the text does not: that the borrowed-vessel fee ROSE, and that it COERCED households into tar burning; the text states the fee flatly, as one of two deductions inside a pay calculation. Exactly one defensible answer.

arithmetic_recheck.verdict: THE i-FÖLJD CONTRADICTION IS GENUINELY CURED, AND NO OTHER PASSAGE ARITHMETIC CONFLICTS.
arithmetic_recheck.the_cured_item: P4 now reads 'för åren 1863 till 1866 saknas hela band, och en föreståndare på 1870-talet nöjde sig med att skriva efternamn, men serien sträcker sig ändå över fyrtiotvå år.' 'Sträcker sig över' asserts a SPAN, which four missing volumes inside it do not falsify; 'täcker ... i följd' asserted unbroken COVERAGE, which they did. The concessive 'men ... ändå' now carries both listed defects instead of only the second. The number 42 is retained and is now true of the span.
full_sweep: Span vs frame: the works bought charcoal 'under 1800-talets andra hälft' (1850–1900, 50 years); a 42-year span fits, with room for the gap. No conflict.

Every dated event lands inside a feasible 42-year window: the 1863–1866 gap, a föreståndare 'på 1870-talet', prices 'på 1870-talet', an 1868 debt standing 'oförändrad i tolv år' (to 1880), and Nyfeldt's 'kronans avverkningstillstånd på 1860-talet'. No conflict.
The 1840s sockenstämmoprotokoll concern the forest administration's complaints about stubbrytning, not the works' account series, and the text never places them inside it. No conflict.
Kiln timing: 'sex till nio dygn' of charring against 'ett par timmar räckte för att göra en hel veckas arbete till aska' — a week sits inside 6–9 dygn. Consistent.
Pay: 'omkring nittio öre' per stig with 'en dryg tredjedel' returning to the works as two named deductions. Internally consistent; no figure is given that could contradict it.
Field remains: 'drygt niohundra kolbottnar och sjuttiotvå tjärdalar' registered, 'fem till tolv meter tvärs över'. No dependency, no conflict.
Glossary: 'stig = ... ungefär tolv tunnor' is consistent with every use of stig in the passage.
arithmetic_recheck.the_one_stretch_examined_and_cleared: The two-mil figure was the target of the earlier repair and was re-examined adversarially. 'Två mil ... är ungefär så långt ett hästekipage hann köra åt ett håll utan att lasta om och ändå vara hemma igen innan en kort vinterdag var slut' implies a ~40 km round trip in a short winter day, which is at the upper edge of what a loaded horse sled does. It is NOT an internal contradiction: it reconciles with 'Nästan alla leverantörer ... inom drygt två mil' (which the pre-repair round-trip reading did not), it is doubly hedged ('ungefär', 'konstaterar han'), and it is attributed to a fictional researcher as an estimate rather than asserted as measurement. Recorded as examined-and-cleared, not as a finding.

gstem_dispositions.preamble: verdicts-ruling/verdicts-gstem.jsonl returns flag on all four targets for this cid, nine findings in total, zero kills. Blind classifications: q1 WORLD_KNOWLEDGE (pick B), q2 PARTIALLY (pick B — i.e. the blind solver got q2 WRONG, which is the desired result and the strongest single evidence in the round that the passage is load-bearing), q3 PARTIALLY (pick A), q4 WORLD_KNOWLEDGE (pick C). Every finding gets a written disposition below, as required. Two of the nine are REJECTED on their premises, the other seven are ACCEPTED as accurate observations that do not block.

q1_f1_world_knowledge_pick_B.disposition: ACCEPTED AS ACCURATE, NOT BLOCKING, AND ALREADY OWNER-ADJUDICATED.
q1_f1_world_knowledge_pick_B.reasoning: The finding is correct: air ingress converting pyrolysis to combustion is decidable without the passage, and it is the weakest passage-dependence in the unit. Three things settle it. (i) The gate itself declines to escalate: 'Process comprehension, not a date/name lookup, and a passage would ground it — flag, not RECALL_ONLY.' (ii) The property is unchanged by this repair — q1 is byte-identical to HEAD across prompt, all four options, key and rationale — so it is not a regression and cannot be a reason to refuse a repair round's output. (iii) It was placed before the owner: ADJUDICATION.md lists it under las-b14-001's 'Flaggor och öppna poster' with the same blindval-B finding, the adjudicator declined to raise it to ÄGARBLICK, and the ÄGARDOM approved the unit subject to exactly two named changes, neither of which touches q1. Carrying it as a live objection now would re-litigate a decided point.

q1_f2_D_eliminable_by_form.reasoning: True and unchanged: 'ofelbart ... oavsett hur snabbt' does contradict the stem's presupposition that timeliness matters. But this is what an overgeneralisation trap IS — planted_traps['1']['D'] declares it — and one form-discardable option out of three distractors still leaves A and C requiring the passage (both are unhedged, both are thermally plausible to a non-reader, and the blind leg had to use domain knowledge to rule them out, which is precisely why it classified WORLD_KNOWLEDGE rather than deciding on form alone). Unchanged by the repair. No action.

q2_f1_A_reverses_stem_premise.reasoning: Correct and by design. The repair_log names this itself and correctly classifies it as stem-internal rather than a cross-question channel: 'q2/A is still eliminable from the stem alone, because it reverses the premise the stem states, but that is stem-internal and not a cross-question channel.' A property_swap distractor in a why-question whose stem states the direction is always eliminable by a careful reader; the item's difficulty lives in B vs C vs D, all three of which survive the stem. Unchanged by the repair.

q2_f2_B_vs_D_split_routed_to_content_gat.disposition: ACCEPTED, AND ANSWERED IN WRITING HERE — THIS IS THE ONE G-STEM FINDING THAT REQUIRED A CONTENT ANSWER, AND IT RESOLVES FOR D.
q2_f2_B_vs_D_split_routed_to_content_gat.reasoning: The gate did exactly the right thing: blind, B and D are both true of Swedish bruk economics and both answer the stem, so it declined to decide and routed the key-defensibility question to the gates that read the passage. With the passage, D is uniquely defensible and B is disqualified — not merely unsupported. The discriminator is the stem's 'enligt texten' plus P3's explicit designation sentence: 'Den skillnaden avgjorde var hantverken kunde bedrivas', where 'den skillnaden' refers to the durability contrast the two preceding sentences establish. B substitutes a DIFFERENT cause (bulk, value density) for the one the text names as decisive, and the text supplies neither a volume comparison nor a tar price with which to build B's case. Adversarially probed: the glossary's 'stig = ... ungefär tolv tunnor' plus 'nittio öre' per stig give a partial numeric foothold for B's bulk half, but no tar price is given anywhere, so the value-density half cannot be completed from the text at all. Two independent G-KEY rounds (r1, r2) landed D citing that same designation sentence, and G-DISTRACTOR passed q2. Not a double key. Recorded separately at info severity (VF4-I3) that this is the unit's genuine difficulty and that the WHY-B rationale clause handles it with a load-bearing qualifier.

q3_f1_test_wiseness_stack_lands_on_A.disposition: ACCEPTED AS ACCURATE, NOT BLOCKING — AND DISPOSED OF ON THE SAME GROUND THE OWNER ALREADY APPLIED TO las-b14-002 q3 IN THIS SAME ÄGARDOM.
q3_f1_test_wiseness_stack_lands_on_A.reasoning: The observation is fair: among an over-absolute C, an off-scope D and a self-defeating B, A is the only well-formed alternative-explanation option. The gate does not convict on it — 'one alternative-explanation option among an absolutist, an off-detail and a muddled option is also the ordinary shape of authentic HP objection items, so per calibration this goes to adjudication.' The written disposition is: with the passage, A is uniquely defensible and each of B, C, D fails on a distinct TEXTUAL ground rather than a formal one — B reverses the arrow Nyfeldt actually draws, C attributes a source-nihilism the text never gives her, D attributes to her a reservation the text places in the description of Bostrand's material. That is deliberate distractor architecture, and it is the same reasoning the ÄGARDOM accepted verbatim for las-b14-002 q3 ('den formella G-STEM-lutningen ... bedöms som avsiktlig distraktorarkitektur'). Note also that this is not a repair artefact: q3/A, /B and /C are byte-identical to HEAD.

q3_f2_repair_side_effect_D_reads_as_fill.disposition: PREMISE REJECTED. The observation about D's blind discardability is accurate; the attribution of it to the repair is not, and this audit declines to record a regression that the diff does not support.
q3_f2_repair_side_effect_D_reads_as_fill.reasoning: The gate calls this a 'Repair side-effect' and says the rewrite 'strengthens the form-based elimination on this question'. Direct comparison of the two texts refutes that. OLD D: 'Att Bostrand borde ha räknat leveranserna i vikt i stället för i stig, eftersom finkolet snedvrider siffrorna.' NEW D: 'Att Bostrand borde ha uteslutit 1870-talets poster, eftersom föreståndaren då nöjde sig med att skriva efternamn.' Identical rhetorical frame ('Att Bostrand borde ha <methodological remedy>, eftersom <defect in the material>'), identical off-scope-ness relative to a stem that asks for an objection to the BOUNDARY'S INTERPRETATION, and therefore identical blind discardability. If anything the new D is marginally LESS discardable blind, since excluding a decade of delivery entries at least bears on the data that constitute the boundary, whereas re-weighing stig in kilograms bears only on units. The gate saw the post-repair sheet and had no pre-repair sheet to compare against; this audit has both. Disposition: the residual — that q3's fourth option is a weak option — is real, PRE-EXISTING, unchanged in strength, and already covered by the q3_f1 disposition above. The repair removed a leak at no cost to discardability, which is a strict improvement. Additionally, and against the gate's 'filler' characterisation, the new D is a better trap WITH the passage than the old one was: Nyfeldt does make one further remark about evidentiary limits ('kronans avverkningstillstånd på 1860-talet var både få och kortvariga'), so a hasty reader can now half-recognise 'Nyfeldt said something about a decade and about thin records' and land on D — a decade-and-object near-miss (1870s vs 1860s; bookkeeping vs felling permits) that the old measurement objection could not create, because Nyfeldt never touches units at all. G-DISTRACTOR, which reads the passage, passed q3.

q4_f1_B_and_D_fall_to_form.disposition: SPLIT — ACCEPTED for B, PREMISE REJECTED for D.
q4_f1_B_and_D_fall_to_form.reasoning: B: accepted. 'Så gott som varje torparhushåll' does overreach a stem that says only that the same household COULD do both, and that is the declared overgeneralisation trap. Not blocking; unchanged by the repair (q4/B is byte-identical to HEAD). D: the stated ground — that D 'is a causal origin claim that does not answer "vad kan man dra för slutsats av att samma hushåll kunde bedriva båda hantverken" — a stem-form mismatch' — does not survive comparison with the KEY. Key C reads 'Att kombinationen var möjlig framför allt därför att arbetstopparna låg i olika delar av året': that is itself a causal explanation of the dual-craft fact, not a consequence of it. C and D have the SAME logical form relative to this stem; the two differ in textual support, not in form. If D failed the stem's form, so would the key. What is true is that D is discardable blind for asserting unverifiable specifics ('allt högre avgifter'), which is the ordinary signature of a plausible_worldknowledge trap and not a form defect.

q4_f2_cross_question_seasonal_cue_plus_d.disposition: ACCEPTED AS THE ONE REAL RESIDUAL SOFT CHANNEL — WEIGHED, PRE-EXISTING, AND TOO WEAK TO BLOCK. Not repaired, and repair is not recommended.
q4_f2_cross_question_seasonal_cue_plus_d.reasoning: This is the soft q3→q4 channel the tasking asked to be weighed. Four things bound it. (i) It is PRE-EXISTING and untouched: the carriers are q3/A ('hur långt vinterns slädar kom') and q3/B ('så långt ut som slädarna nådde'), both byte-identical to HEAD, so the repair neither created nor widened it. (ii) It cannot establish what C asserts. C claims a CONTRAST between two crafts' work peaks; the q3 sheet supplies a season for ONE craft and nothing whatever about tar's calendar, and a contrast cannot be inferred from one term. (iii) It points at the wrong season. q3's cue is winter SLED HAULAGE, whereas the passage places the charcoal WORK peak 'från sensommaren och in i oktober' — so a solver leaning on the cue is being pulled toward a false premise about when charcoal work happened, which makes the cue mildly misleading rather than corroborating. (iv) The gate itself attributes its blind pick primarily to domain knowledge ('the complementary-season account is also the standard historiography of by-employment') and explicitly declines to call the item decided: 'A (shared know-how) stays substantively live, so the item is not decided blind.' Residual accepted at note level in findings (VF4-N4). Repairing it would mean rewriting q3/A or q3/B — an option edit pulling another full blind re-gate round — to remove a cue that points the wrong way, which fails cost/benefit.

q4_f3_repair_side_effect_D_no_longer_ans.disposition: PREMISE REJECTED, twice over. The channel-closure half is ACCEPTED and independently confirmed.
q4_f3_repair_side_effect_D_no_longer_ans.reasoning: Accepted: 'the rewritten D contains no bulk, value-per-barrel, friability or transport content, so it does not hand q:2's answer — the q:4 -> q:2 channel is closed.' This audit reproduced that from the sheet independently. Rejected: 'The cost is that D no longer answers the stem's inferential form.' First, 'no longer' is false as a matter of diff. OLD D: 'Att hushållen tvingades till tjärbränning sedan bruket börjat dra av allt större summor för smulat kol.' NEW D: 'Att hushållen tvingades till tjärbränning sedan bruket börjat ta ut allt högre avgifter för lånade kärl.' The frame 'Att hushållen tvingades till tjärbränning sedan bruket börjat <rising charge>' is preserved word for word; only the charge's referent moved. Whatever relation the option bears to the stem's form, it bore identically before the repair, so no cost was incurred. Second, as argued at q4_f1 above, the alleged mismatch does not hold at all, because the key is an explanation of the same shape. Net: the repair closed a channel at zero cost to this option's stem-fit, and 'fourth-option discard' overstates it.

gsprak_dispositions.summary: Three legs, all flag, seven findings, all severity minor, zero on any span this repair touched. Verified by exact-string test: neither of the two rewritten options, nor the rewritten passage clause, nor either rewritten rationale clause is quoted by any of the three legs. The edited spans are language-clean.
convictions: q2/B 'gav ett högt värde per tunna' — flagged by ALL THREE legs (class 6, collocation: 'ge ett värde' is the measurement idiom, not the commercial one). Recorded as the one live minor, VF4-M1 below.
q1/D 'hela lasten' — leg 1 only; 'lasten' is used elsewhere in the passage for charcoal in transit, so 'hela milan' would be the register-native choice.
q4 stem 'Vad kan man, utifrån texten, dra för slutsats ...' — leg 2 only; the split 'vad ... för slutsats' with a wedged parenthetical reads clunkier than the other three stems.
